title: Role hierarchy construction determines the public decision
summary: The legacy and fluent graphs propagate A to B and B to C and D under either prefix. A real authority manager decides from the selected authorities.

change.description: The legacy and fluent graphs propagate A to B and B to C and D under either prefix. A real authority manager decides from the selected authorities.

notes: The pre-feature artifact supplies the legacy API only. The client links its optional builder path against landed code and executes it only where the original runtime provides it. The historical core uses the setup graph with released 6.2.0 crypto. The release graph uses Security 6.3.0 and Framework 6.1.7.

Each prefix granted 14 of the 16 authority subsets. The distinct before, feature, landed and release JARs were loaded on the JVM. The 64-history combined caller made 56 third edits and preserved the field error even on all eight declined writes.
